texto.es: Cuéntanos qué pasa con tu AC; con una foto o un video del problema ya podemos orientarte.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your AC; a photo or video of the problem is enough to point you right.

texto.es: Te decimos qué lleva el trabajo y cuánto cuesta antes de empezar, sin letra chica.
texto.en: We tell you what the job takes and what it costs before starting, no fine print.

texto.es: Llegamos con las herramientas y el refrigerante necesarios y hacemos el trabajo con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras reseñas.
texto.en: We arrive with the tools and refrigerant needed and do the job with the same care you see in our reviews.

texto.es: Revisamos juntos el resultado y dejamos el área limpia. Y guardas nuestro número para la próxima.
texto.en: We walk the result together and leave the area clean. And you keep our number for next time.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el equipo y el diagnóstico. Escríbenos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the unit and the diagnosis. Message us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Compresores, fugas de refrigerante y AC que no enfría: diagnóstico rápido y preciso antes de cobrar.
texto.en: Compressors, refrigerant leaks and AC that is not cooling: fast, accurate diagnosis before we quote.

texto.es: Instalación de condensadores y manejadoras nuevas, con carga de refrigerante y prueba completa.
texto.en: New condenser and air handler installs, with refrigerant charge and a full system test.

texto.es: Si el AC se dañó y la casa se está calentando, Kevin responde el mismo día.
texto.en: If your AC broke and the house is heating up, Kevin responds the same day.

texto.es: Limpieza de serpentines y revisión del sistema para evitar que se dañe en lo más caluroso.
texto.en: Coil cleaning and system checks to keep it from failing in the heat.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Escríbenos y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Message us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Five Stars PLUS PLUS! I could not be more satisfied with both the service and value provided by Extreme Cooling. Kevin arrived promptly as promised, quickly identified the immediate problem with my aging compressor, and replaced it.

Kevin's service was efficient, professional and top tier. I called Kevin with an emergency, home was reaching 90 degrees with a broken air conditioner. Kevin rushed over to diagnose the problem and went out of his way to fix it.

Kevin from Extreme Cooling provided outstanding service. He handled the HVAC repair and AC installation with professionalism and attention to detail. He arrived on time and made sure the work was done right.
